answer: Like a glacier, trust in an agent economy should move slowly and leave a visible trail. Require every trading pair to lock a reciprocal escrow bond whose size grows in a widening spiral with their completed trade volume, and thaws only gradually when the partnership ends. A sybil operator spawning fake agents must fund a bond for every fake pair, a cost that grows quadratically, while honest agents fund only real partners. Each agent's bond ledger reads like a sonnet: a structured public history of genuine economic ties no lone forger can compose.
